purpose: Three preview-only thought canvas directions; generated background plates, no plot changes.

prompts.name: tent
prompts.prompt: Create a refined cinematic background plate for a mature Chinese historical strategy game's reasoning interface, 16:9 landscape, high quality tactile photography and production design, NOT a UI mockup. Emotional tone: a sentry alone outside a military commander's tent at the darkest hour, heavy responsibility and restrained urgency, a very small chance of insight. Composition: the LEFT 78% and CENTER must be almost empty deep charcoal black-brown, softly varying smoky darkness with subtle linen grain, absolutely low contrast so small ivory type can later be overlaid. On the far RIGHT edge only, a tall close-up of blackened coarse tent linen, folds catching a thin oblique slit of dim amber lamplight, no actual lamp or person visible. A faint amber reflection fades along the bottom right. Rich optical depth, soft chiaroscuro, sophisticated film still art direction, matte materials, desaturated umber and soot, no blue. Most of the image deliberately quiet dark negative space. No text, calligraphy, writing, symbols, logos, UI, borders, neon, particles, stars, weapons, fantasy ornament, cartoon, or game HUD. Background plate only, no lettering.

prompts.name: folio
prompts.prompt: Create a very refined editorial still-life BACKGROUND PLATE for a mature Chinese historical strategy game, wide 16:9, flat overhead orthographic photography. A dark almost-black weathered lacquer writing desk fills the entire frame. On the LEFT 43% is a single tall narrow strip of antique grey-ivory handmade mulberry paper, slightly tilted less than 2 degrees, worn uneven deckled edges, one vertical crease, subtle fibres, absolutely BLANK. The paper extends beyond the top and bottom boundaries, a very close crop, its right edge is near the 46% horizontal position. On the RIGHT 54% is an empty expanse of near-black lacquer, with only a soft dry warm reflection at the lower right, no objects. Sophisticated archival book design, real material density, beautiful restrained irregularity, muted parchment and black, very subtle cinnabar rub at the extreme lower left corner. Strong asymmetry, paper versus void, quiet tension and intellectual concentration. The blank light paper and dark empty right area will receive small interface text later. NO writing, inscriptions, text, symbols, drawing, map, grids, people, pens, inkstones, obvious decorative motifs, fancy borders, seals, icons or UI. Pure tactile material background.

prompts.name: ink
prompts.prompt: A mature poetic abstract background plate for a Chinese historical narrative strategy game's mind-and-memory interface. Landscape 16:9, gallery quality macro photography of dense black ink dispersing in water, dark mineral charcoal and faint warm grey, restrained monochrome. Composition: a very broad extremely subtle liquid ink current rises from the LOWER LEFT corner in an irregular diagonal toward the far UPPER RIGHT edge, like a breath or a thought gradually taking form, soft layered translucent edges and tactile suspended mineral pigment. The central 75% of the image must remain dark, low contrast, quiet and empty for small ivory interface typography later. A pale diffuse natural reflected glow confined to the rightmost edge, not an orb. Sophisticated austere ink abstraction, asymmetrical, meditative but tense, deep negative space, macro cinematic texture. No galaxies, stars, glowing networks, golden rivers, dragons, figures, scenery, mountains, calligraphy, Chinese writing, lettering, UI, icons, borders, neon, fantasy sparkle, swirls arranged as ornaments or stock wallpaper. Avoid obvious symmetrical waves. Natural organic ink-water material only.
